SALAMA TAKAFUL INSURANCE LIMITED
TAKAFUL FIRE AND ALLIED PERILS - POLICY WORDING
Clause 1. Operative clause
In consideration of the contribution paid, the Takaful operator will indemnify the Participant against loss of or damage to the property described, caused by fire, lightning or explosion.
Clause 6. Claims conditions
6.1 The Participant shall take all reasonable steps to minimise the loss.
6.2 Notice of claim must be given in writing within 7 days of the loss, failing which the operator may decline liability.
Clause 9. Governing law
This policy is governed by the laws of Kenya.
